title: DynamicPage
description: Fiori dynamic page: sticky title (heading, breadcrumbs, KPIs, actions), header that snaps on scroll, expand/collapse and pin buttons, floating footer.

usage.summary: Compose a page with a structured title, collapsing header, scrolling content and optional finalizing footer.
useWhen: Work with business content while keeping essential context and page actions available as the header collapses.
Build a freestyle full-screen page or a page inside one FlexibleColumnLayout column.
Keep filters or supporting header information accessible through expansion and pinning; leave page actions available when the header is snapped.

avoidWhen.when: Need only a header bar, scrolling content and footer without structured collapsing header content.
Organize one object into sections with anchor or tab navigation.
Start from a complete record-search page with saved filters, results and mass actions.
Show a product-home greeting or hero that scrolls away (5.75rem/92px minimum height; 24rem/384px recommended maximum).
